models/group_net.py: DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPES = ('policy', 'float16', 'float32', 'float32_fine'); add FLOAT32_FINE_STAGES = ('d2', 'd1'). DeformDecoder.__init__(self, level, config=None, float32_stages=(), **kwargs): validate float32_stages is a subset of DECODER_STAGES; for each (name, width) build `up_<name>` (TrilinearUpsample2x or None) and the block inside precision.policy_scope('float32') when name in float32_stages, else contextlib.nullcontext(); build svf_norm_act inside the float32 scope when float32_stages is non-empty; svf_head unchanged (dtype='float32'). Store self.float32_stages = tuple(float32_stages).

DeformDecoder.call: keep `x = tf.cast(skips[5], self.compute_dtype)`; inside the stage loop, before `if up is not None`, add `x = tf.cast(x, block.compute_dtype)` (no-op when equal, so policy/float16/float32 graphs do not change); skip cast `tf.cast(skip, x.dtype)` stays; before the head `x_head = tf.cast(x, self.svf_norm_act.compute_dtype)`; dec_feat = d1 output (unchanged). Update both docstrings (DeformDecoder: per-stage dtype; GroupRegLevelModel: mode table policy/float16/float32/float32_fine, variables float32 with identical names/order/shapes in all modes so checkpoints, warm start, copy_weights_from, --cascade-from and resume are compatible across modes; frozen cascade stages are always float32 whatever this flag is).

GroupRegLevelModel.__init__: keep the float32 outer scope for 'float32'; for 'float32_fine' with global compute != 'float32' construct DeformDecoder(..., float32_stages=FLOAT32_FINE_STAGES) without an outer scope; under a float32 global policy float32_fine = no-op (float32_stages=()). Keep the existing float16-needs-mixed check.

models/cascade.py: extend the module docstring 'Float32' row: the trainable model's --deform-decoder-dtype / fp16 knobs never apply to frozen stages (always float32, decision D2; frozen stages ran float32 in the m9 NaN probe). No code change.

runtime/args.py: --deform-decoder-dtype choices add 'float32_fine'; help: 'float32_fine = only the full- and half-resolution decoder stages d2, d1 (+ upsamples) and the SVF norm/head in float32, d5..d3 stay float16'; validation: `args.deform_decoder_dtype in ('float32', 'float32_fine') and not deform` -> parser.error('--deform-decoder-dtype %s needs 'deform' in --task-ratio'); module docstring bullet updated.

slurm/r_level4.sh, slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh: `need_choice DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPE ... policy float16 float32 float32_fine`; linear-only drop condition `[ "$DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPE" = float32 ] || [ "$DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPE" = float32_fine ]` with the same NOTE; header comment lines mention float32_fine. slurm/m9_level1_cascade.sh: case adds float32_fine (error text 'policy, float16, float32 or float32_fine'), header comment line.

Tests in tests/test_fp16_mitigations.py: new class TestFloat32FineDecoder(MixedPolicyCase): (a) helper `decoder_dtypes(model)` -> {layer.name: compute_dtype} over [dec] + dec.submodules (Keras layers only); for the level-2 repro model and a level-1 TINY model (GroupRegLevelModel(1, tiny_config(deform_decoder=True, seed=1), ...).build_model(1)) check: 'float32_fine' -> d2, d1, up_d2/up_d1 when present, svf_norm_act and all their submodules float32, svf_head float32, the DeformDecoder itself + d5, d4, d3 + up_d5..up_d3 and their submodules float16, encoder float16, global policy still mixed_float16; 'policy' and 'float16' -> all decoder layers float16 except svf_head; (b) overflow repro: w = overflow_weights(policy model) (k=1e5) makes the policy model non-finite (precondition) while a float32_fine model with the same weights gives finite v_raw, v, u, u_inv and a finite deform_terms loss; (c) without overflow (only the svf head randomised as in test_dtypes_and_match_float32_model) float32_fine v_raw within 2e-2 * max|v32| + 1e-6 of the float32-policy model; (d) under MP.set_global_policy('float32'), float32_fine builds a graph with the same op types as policy (pattern TestOffAddsNoOps.graph_ops); (e) parameterise test_amp_trainer_full_ckpt_lean_split over ('float32', 'float32_fine') with subTest (free_memory between) and for float32_fine assert d1.conv float32 and d3.conv float16.

TestCheckpointCompatibility: generalise test_checkpoint_roundtrip_between_dtypes to modes ('policy', 'float32', 'float32_fine'): identical lists of variable dtypes, local names and shapes for all modes; tf.train.Checkpoint write/read + assert_existing_objects_matched for every ordered pair (values equal); copy_weights_from across modes. New test_warm_start_model_across_dtypes: `from tests.test_cascade import save_run` (or copy the helper) -> level-4 run of tiny_config(deform_decoder=True) saved; for dtype in ('float32', 'float32_fine'): m = GroupRegLevelModel(4, cfg, deform_decoder_dtype=dtype).build_model(2); info = C.warm_start_model(m, cfg, paths['ckpt_last']); assert info['mode'] == 'full' and every weight equals the source model's.

tests/test_cascade.py TestFrozenStageFactories: new test_cascade_copy_into_float32_decoders: save_run source (tiny_config(deform_decoder=True)), C.load_cascade_source + C.check_cascade_config(cfg, src_cfg); under mixed_float16 for dtype in ('float32', 'float32_fine'): frozen = cascade.FrozenStage.from_checkpoint(prefix, src_cfg); every layer of frozen.model (incl. deform_decoder submodules) compute dtype float32; trainable = GroupRegLevelModel(2, cfg, deform_decoder_dtype=dtype).build_model(2); trainable.copy_weights_from(frozen.source_model) == len(weights) and all weights equal; float32_fine: trainable.deform_decoder.d1.conv float32 and d3.conv float16. Also a level-1 variant through cascade.FrozenChain.from_models(model4, model2) with a level-1 float32_fine TINY trainable model copying chain.source_model, if it fits the 6000 MB cap (otherwise record 'level-1 variant skipped: <reason>' in findings).

tests/test_runtime_infra.py test_nonfinite_flags: '--amp true --task-ratio rigid:1,deform:1 --deform-decoder-dtype float32_fine' parses; float32_fine without --amp and with a linear-only ratio -> parser errors naming the flag. tests/test_slurm_scripts.py test_m9_level1_mitigations and tests/test_sweep_tools.py mitigation tests: DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPE=float32_fine emits '--deform-decoder-dtype float32_fine' (all four scripts), r_level4 linear-only drops it with the NOTE, invalid values still exit 2 (update error-message expectations).

NIT 1 test in tests/test_trainer.py TestNonfiniteGuard: test_lso_flag_ignores_gradient_only_overflow: AMP (mixed_float16, restore float32 in finally), self.amp_model(), LossScaleOptimizer initial_scale 2.0 ** 40, seed from _find_seed(self.RATIO, pred) with >= 2 deform draws early; _KernelSwitchSource(self.dgroup['batch'], d1 kernel, good, bad, range(1, 2)) so only the 2nd deform step has a NaN kernel; fit up to the 2nd deform step; assert deform step 1 not finite with a finite loss (gradient-only overflow; skip the test with a clear message if the scale does not overflow), deform step 2 has non-finite loss and lso_skipped False, and the loss scale was halved at both deform steps (compare with the scale sequence from the loss-scale log key or opt.loss_scale before/after via train_step calls, following test_lso_not_halved_by_streaking_task). Existing test_lso_not_halved_by_streaking_task and test_gradient_overflow_and_isolated_nan_unchanged must pass unchanged.

NIT 2 (docs only): runtime/args.py --nonfinite-patience-task help + module docstring bullet, and runtime/run.py docstring 'ckpt/last protection': with 0 (guard off) a task stuck in a permanent hard-failure streak defers every ckpt/last save including the final one for the rest of the run (visible as ckpt_last_deferred / ckpt_last_skipped_final events); a resume then rewinds to the pre-streak state; keep the guard on or restart from ckpt/best*.
